meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 tip 时,Claude 会先列出真实 tip 清单、读你的 settings.json 判断你实际能看到哪些,再读源码核对该功能的行为,最后用你提问的语言给出深入解释并引用具体文件路径。
howto.when: 当你问起某条 tip(比如 TUI 里的 Tip: 行)、某个 tip 提到的功能做什么,或你能看到哪些 tip 时触发。

say.text: TUI 里那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 先查 tip 清单,再解释那一条

say.text: 我现在实际能看到哪些 tip?
讲讲 Fable 5 拒绝后那条 tip 的机制。
say.note: 会引用 fallback-architect 源码路径

howto.what_en: When you ask about a tip, Claude first lists the real tip catalog, reads your settings.json to see which tips you personally can see, verifies the feature in source code, then explains it deeply in your own language with file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What was that Tip: line in the TUI?
say_en.note: It lists the catalog first, then explains that tip.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json to answer.

say_en.text: Walk me through the mechanism behind the Fable 5 refusal tip.
